notes: «قال وسمعت الحسن بن علي الحلواني» makes Hasan the link; «رأيت في كتاب عفان حديث هشام» gives Affan as the route by his book (written transmission), which is not spelled as «عن»: the reading is my best one, flagged
«قال هشام حدثني رجل يقال له يحيى بن فلان عن محمد بن كعب» gives Hisham's route: Yahya b. Fulan, then Muhammad b. Ka'b
«قلت لعفان ... فقال إنما ابتلي» is a dispute about the route, Affan's answer is an evaluation, not a saying: not added as a second link
the first-person «قلت» and the chain's implicit book transmission are why this is flagged (rule 11)
